result.summary: This PR adds a functional test to test/functional/rpc_packages.py verifying that submitpackage correctly reports other-wtxid when a same-txid-different-witness transaction is submitted while its counterpart is already in the mempool. The test submits child_one directly to the mempool then submits child_two (same txid, different witness) via submitpackage, asserting the RPC response correctly identifies the existing mempool transaction via other-wtxid rather than erroring. The author verified the test can actually fail by temporarily asserting a wrong wtxid.
result.problem: The other-wtxid behavior in submitpackage (tied to a TODO about witness replacement in packages) had only unit-test coverage of the underlying mempool logic, not functional coverage of the RPC's actual JSON output, leaving a gap that could let a regression in the RPC-level reporting go unnoticed.
